assessment.summary: IL6R (P08887) is a well-validated, clinically proven drug target with two approved biologic antagonists (tocilizumab and sarilumab) and multiple high-resolution crystal structures including ligand-bound complexes. The target has strong disease validation across inflammatory and oncological indications, though small-molecule chemical matter is essentially absent from ChEMBL, reflecting the dominance of antibody-based modalities for this extracellular receptor.
evidence_gaps: No small-molecule IC50 data in ChEMBL despite approved drugs existing — chemical tractability for small molecules is undemonstrated
Best resolution is 2.4Å, just at the threshold; no sub-2Å structures reported, limiting fine-grained structure-based drug design for small molecules
AlphaFold mean pLDDT of 77.9 with only 67.5% high-confidence residues suggests some disordered regions not well-captured by existing structures
Approved drugs are exclusively monoclonal antibodies; no approved small molecules or peptide inhibitors targeting IL6R
Binding site geometry for small-molecule engagement of the IL-6/IL-6R protein-protein interface has not been well characterised in the available data
No allosteric or intracellular binding site data provided
